0.0: You've waited so long, Evan. I've finally found the clue about the culprit who stole the #t4032464#! Finally, #m103000000# will clear its name! Or soon...because there seems to be one more problem.
0.1: I sent one of my people undercover in #b#m105040300##k, but he was just so weak. He got the clue all right, but lost it to a #o4230102# who attacked him on the way to #m103000000#.
0.2: If you're not too busy, can you find the document for me? You can get it back easily by hunting a couple #o4230102# monsters. That should be cake for a burly hero like you, right?
0.3: Go to the Subway and eliminate #r#o3230101##k and #r#o4230102##k monsters to get the #b#t4032463##k back. We can restore #m103000000#'s honor! If you care about that sort of thing.

no.0: Hm... I've been hearing nothing but good things about your strength, from #p1022007# to #p1040000#. Are they all lies?

1.0: Oh, you've brought the #t4032463#! You probably won't be able to read it since it's in a code that only Thieves can read. Here, let me see it. I'll be able to find out who is responsible for all of this!

item.0: You haven't found the #b#t4032463##k yet? The #r#o3230101##k or #r#o4230102##k monsters will have them in the Subway! Please get it back, to restore the honor of #m103000000#!
